invariants.description: Every string id is unique across nodes, edges and groups together. Ids are compared exactly: "a" and "A" are different ids. The path points at each later use of the id.
An edge's from and to must each be the string id of an existing node. Numbers are never coerced to strings, and a group or edge id does not count as a node.
invariants.message: Edge {edge} field {end} points to missing node {ref}

invariants.description: An edge whose from equals its to is only allowed when its kind is listed in the selfLoopKinds option.
invariants.message: Edge {edge} connects node {node} to itself and kind {kind} does not allow that

invariants.description: Every entry in a group's members list must be the string id of an existing node.
A node belongs to at most one group. The first group (lowest index) that lists it owns it; each listing in a later group is reported. Listing a node twice in the same group is not this error.
A node's x, y, w and h must be present and be finite numbers. NaN, Infinity, numbers too large for a 64-bit float, strings, booleans and null are all rejected.
invariants.message: Node {node} field {field} must be a finite number

invariants.description: A node's w and h must not be below zero. Negative zero counts as zero.
A node's label should be a string with at least one character outside blankCodePoints. A missing or non-string label also gets this warning.
The nodes list may hold at most maxNodes items and the edges list at most maxEdges items.
